design: Both copying templates/delimiters, all edited cases retained. Partition every source position into six exhaustive groups. Include local and persistent value paths. Replace each group by its base-prompt counterpart or delete it; source-specific additive output changes, later computation live.
scope: Base replacement removes the contextual change; deletion removes the entire native contribution. They answer different questions. Coarse token groups do not identify semantics or unique causal paths.
